Subject: Pilot stalled — auth rewrite blocking integration; asking for trial reprieve and extra sandbox credit

Hi Vivek / Ben,

Quick context: our engineering team rolled a security update last night that replaced our legacy SAML flow with a new OIDC provider. The change had a breaking side-effect for third-party webhook auth: tokens from your SDK are currently rejected in our staging environment. Our engineers dug in and the fix will take roughly 10–14 business days because the IDP migration forced a small rewrite on our side (we underestimated the SSO dependency graph).

This blocks our pilot evaluation — we were planning a demo next week and now can't exercise the end-to-end flows. Given the delay, can Redwood provide a short trial reprieve and additional sandbox credits so we can continue experimenting against a mocked auth endpoint while our fix lands? Specifically we are requesting: 3-week trial extension + 25k token sandbox credit.

I've attached a short error log from staging that shows the token rejection (sso-error-log.txt) and a brief checklist of what we need to validate (altrix-checklist.pdf). If useful, happy to set up a joint troubleshooting session — our eng leads are on this thread.

Thanks — really want to keep momentum here.

— Elena Morales
VP Product, Altrix.ai

I'll need final sign-off from my manager (Vivek) to make the credit permanent and to approve the full 25k request.

- Vivek — please advise on approval path for additional sandbox credit and length of extension.

Elena — are there any compliance items we need to be aware of for a temporary mocked auth endpoint (PII, session retention)? If yes, flag them and I'll loop in our security lead.
